description: This file appears to be a shell script used for configuring wireless interfaces, network bridge setups, and service management related to a device's bridge mode operation. It includes functions to restart hostapd, modifies configuration files, manages network interfaces and IP addresses, and controls services like dnsmasq and lighttpd.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Function to restart hostapd services by shutting down interfaces and killing related processes, then restarting hostapd with a specific config.
